prompt: Under what section of CRPC was Omar Abdullah placed under preventive detention by the Indian government on the 4th and 5th of August 2019?
answer: Omar Abdullah was placed under preventive detention under **Section 107 of the Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC), 1973**.
